notes.title: So, what's new for Steam?
notes.content:
New for the Steam version of Aeternum
[list]
[*] [b]Online Leaderboards.[/b] Go for that high score in your favorite mode and difficulty!
[*] [b]Achievements.[/b] Show the world your bullet dodging skills. Good enough with a character to beat all the modes at the hardest difficulties? Get an extra special achievement!
[*] [b]Trading Cards.[/b] Collect all the characters of the main cast. Combine them into an arcane badge and get special Aeternum emoticons to use in chat. Try for the extra special Techno-Corgi emoticon!
[*] [b]New Playable Character.[/b] Already played through Ellica's story? See the events of The Missing Students and The Girl in the Hyperspace Closet through the eyes of newcomer technology studies major CeeBee!
[*][b]Updated OpenGL Engine.[/b] XNA is no more, but that doesn't mean it can't live on thanks to FNA! FNA is based on OpenGL for fast and portable video, and OpenAL for portable audio.
[*][b]Expanded Controller Support.[/b] Also thanks to FNA's usage of SDL for platform support, Aeternum now supports a broader range of gamepads, including Playstation controllers which have their own button image support.
[/list]
